attributes.action: free bus travel for under 18s in Greater Manchester
attributes.additional_details:
Over the summer the free bus travel allowed us to go outside more and do stuff like work experience to benefit our future and give us the best chance as success , if you use the bus daily as a child in the bee network it can cost around £480-£520 , many families need this money to buy food and basic necessities. Pls support and sign our petition as it is truly and very beneficial for everyone especially people in poverty.
The increasing crime in Manchester makes us worried about being out late.
attributes.background: we want the Government to debate this petition in parliament as it is very beneficial for the youth in Manchester , it allows us to go out more and benefit our future.

rejection.details:
Decisions about free bus travel for young people on the Bee Network are the responsibility of the Greater Manchester Combined Authority and the Mayor of Greater Manchester, rather than the UK Government or Parliament.

You could raise this issue with the Mayor of Greater Manchester or Transport for Greater Manchester:

https://www.greatermanchester-ca.gov.uk/contact/mayor/

https://tfgm.com/help-and-contact-us

You could also contact your local councillor:

https://www.gov.uk/find-your-local-councillors
